P7526.corridor_notes: This is the '环巢湖天然气高压管线工程' (Huanchaohu / 'ring Chaohu Lake' high-pressure gas pipeline), which GEM's own ResearcherNotes (citing hefei.gov.cn) already describes as two sections: (1) the Hefei-Chaohu section ('He-Chao Line' / 合巢线): Feidong County Dianpu Gas Transmission Station (north shore, connecting to CNOOC's Binhai LNG peak-shaving pipeline) -> Huashan Gas Transmission Station in Anchao Economic Development Zone (east shore, Chaohu City) -- confirmed independently via sina.com.cn and bjx.com.cn coverage of its commissioning on 2026-03-13, ~76km, RMB 6.5 billion investment, annual capacity 10.1 bcm, described as 'a key node' of Anhui's 'three vertical, four horizontal, one ring' provincial trunk network; and (2) the Lujiang-Chaohu section ('Lu-Chao Line'), which appears to correspond to this batch's P7527 (Lubei Gate Station -> Huashan Gas Transmission Station, 119.00km, already tracked as its own operating GEM row -- see duplicate/overlap flag in blockers). Both sections converge on the same Huashan Gas Transmission Station, forming two spokes (north via Feidong/Dianpu, and southwest via Lujiang/Yanqiao) that together loop around the eastern and southern shore of Chaohu Lake -- consistent with the 'ring Chaohu' (环巢湖) name, though it is a two-spoke convergence at Huashan rather than a literal closed loop. This PID's own LengthMergedKm (189.00km) is close to the sum of the two documented sections (~76km He-Chao + ~119km Lu-Chao =~195km, plausibly reconciled by a few km of shared alignment or rounding near Huashan).
P7526.researcher_notes: Endpoints given here (Dianpu -> Huashan) are the He-Chao section specifically, since that is the sub-project with a clear, well-sourced, and currently-relevant (just commissioned March 2026) start/end; per the task's ring-topology instruction these are offered as the 'best two anchor points' for the whole named project even though P7526's full scope (per its own ResearcherNotes) spans both sections. GEM's row for this PID shows Status='construction' with no StartLocation/EndLocation on file, while the He-Chao section's own commissioning coverage says it went into service 2026-03-13 -- i.e. GEM's 'construction' status for this row may be stale relative to the He-Chao section, though could still be accurate if the row is meant to track the Lu-Chao section's completion or the project bundle as a whole.
P7526.blockers: STRUCTURAL OVERLAP FLAG (recommend human adjudication, not resolved here): P7526's own two-section description names a 'Lujiang-Chaohu section (Lu-Chao Line)' that closely matches this batch's P7527 (Lujiang-Chaohu Gas Pipeline, Lubei Gate Station -> Huashan Gas Transmission Station, 119.00km, operating) in name, endpoints, and length -- but P7526 (189km total, construction status) is NOT an exact duplicate of P7527 alone, since it also covers the He-Chao section that has no separate PID in this batch. Left duplicate_of=null because the scopes are not identical (superset vs. component), but flagging for a human to decide whether P7526 should be split/retired in favor of separately-tracked He-Chao and Lu-Chao(=P7527) rows, per the project's own hefei.gov.cn-sourced description. The hefei.gov.cn source cited in GEM's pre-existing ResearcherNotes (https://www.hefei.gov.cn/bmts/110159599.html) returned HTTP 403 on this pass and has no Wayback snapshot -- could not be independently re-verified, so this pass relies on the sina.com.cn / bjx.com.cn commissioning coverage instead.
